Seven comments

Trolley’s

Beautiful tune written by Colin Grant.
In F#m

↳ Posted by Declan on June 29th, 2007.

Who ?

So tell us about Colin Grant, please.

↳ Posted by Kenny on June 29th, 2007.

From his website: raised in Toronto, started out with classical violin at 4, and started taking lessons with Sandy MacIntyre at age 10. Family moved to Cape Breton and he started lessons with Allie Bennett and has now performed all over the island. Nowadays he performs solo as well as with the Acadian group Blou.

↳ Posted by twin fiddler on June 29th, 2007.

Very nice.

↳ Posted by Someone at The Session on July 20th, 2007.
